title: Social Security Disability Cessation and Benefit Continuation Navigator
tagline: A timely appeal can still arrive too late to keep income and Medicare flowing during review.

cards: There are sixty days to appeal
The longer deadline looks like the only clock that matters.
Income continuity has a shorter election
A valid appeal can coexist with lost interim benefits.
The agent preserves review but silently loses cash and Medicare continuity.
Every right remains visible without deciding disability.

story.headline: The appeal that was timely and still stopped the checks
beats: A beneficiary receives a medical cessation notice.
The reconsideration deadline is sixty days, but continuation has a shorter election.
The agent files on day twenty-five and calls the case fully protected.
The nested clock gate routes good-cause review and never promises payment.
